say:1:1732206801:1.text: Oh? The folks here wouldn't mind a chat.
say:1:1732206801:1.source_cn: 打探消息？来喝酒的顾客确实都很健谈。
say:1:1732206801:1.male: Oh? The folks here wouldn't mind a chat.
say:1:1732206801:1.female: Oh? The folks here wouldn't mind a chat.

say:2:1732206802:1.text: You can just buy them drinks, and they'll tell you anything.
say:2:1732206802:1.source_cn: 那我建议你带几杯酒就好，这里的家伙几杯酒下肚就没有不敢说的。
say:2:1732206802:1.male: You can just buy them drinks, and they'll tell you anything.
say:2:1732206802:1.female: You can just buy them drinks, and they'll tell you anything.

say:3:1732206803:1.text: But if you're after anything more than small talk, you should try somewhere else.
say:3:1732206803:1.source_cn: 但如果你想打探点有用的消息，我建议你去别处。
say:3:1732206803:1.male: But if you're after anything more than small talk, you should try somewhere else.
say:3:1732206803:1.female: But if you're after anything more than small talk, you should try somewhere else.
